title: I/O Port Programming
lead: Part 1 (unchanged): lecture 03 and exercises 1 and 2 from this year's slides and peer notes: DDR, PORT and PIN, LED and resistor basics, the blinker in assembly, C and Arduino (systems 1 to 4), delay-loop maths, bitwise operators, the pushbutton, worked exercises. Part 2 (added): the same topics explained from zero for beginners, with diagrams, building circuits by hand, and section L: what the lecturer said in the 2020 recordings.
